title: OpenNPC Persona
description: Everything that makes one NPC a specific person. Dialogue providers (mock, local model, OpenNPC backend) receive this object unchanged and are free to use as much or as little of it as they can.

id.description: Stable identifier. Memory and analytics are keyed on this, never on name.

personalityTraits.description: Free-form adjectives. Providers should treat these as soft guidance, not an enum.

mood.description: Current mood. Unlike traits this is expected to change at runtime.

speakingStyle.description: Natural-language description of how the NPC talks. Passed verbatim to language models.

voice.description: Structured hints about delivery. Useful for providers that cannot read speakingStyle (e.g. the mock provider).

fallbacks.description: What the NPC says when it has nothing relevant to say.

knowledge.description: Facts this NPC knows. Two NPCs can know different (even wrong) things about the same topic.

opinions.description: What this NPC thinks about things, in their own words.

source.description: authored = written by a person; generated = produced by a persona generator.
